Unmodified markdown-it 12.3.2 browser distribution, reused from the existing
repository dependency. MIT license is retained in LICENSE. Upstream source:
https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it/tree/12.3.2

markdown-it.min.js SHA-256: 2e77c809205e08971b002366974580295051cad390a607cc25c12731b066790c
